subject: Post-call: procurement gatekeepers + payment path for Globex
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@globex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: procurement gatekeepers + payment path for Globex

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call recap (short):
- Use case: internal knowledge base search + customer support summarization (pilot to prod).
- Expected concurrent users: 8–12, spiky during business hours.
- Security: standard SOC2 is required; you mentioned vendor onboarding checklist.

Commercial / procurement notes I captured:
- Preferred commercial path: PO-backed invoicing (monthly) is most likely, card is fallback for faster pilots.
- Marketplace interest: exploring AWS Marketplace long-term, but procurement prefers direct PO for the initial contract.
- Approval chain: Michael Chen (Finance sponsor) -> Emily Parker (signatory/CFO) for >$50k commits.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will share our vendor onboarding bundle (questionnaire + checklist + draft MSA).
2) Marissa (sales ops) will coordinate paperwork and invoice cadence options (PO vs card).
3) If useful, we can draft a short Mutual Action Plan with milestone dates for procurement sign-off.

Can you confirm: PO billing cadence (monthly vs net30), and the preferred billing contact? That will speed the vendor registration.

Thanks — I’ll attach the initial docs in a follow-up.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: globex_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (PDF), vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@globex.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@globex.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement gatekeepers + payment path for Globex

Hi Vivek — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming details from our side: 

- Procurement preference: PO (monthly invoicing) for vendor agreements during pilot -> production. Card payments require additional approvals and will slow timelines.
- Billing contact (for PO processing): michael.chen@globex.com (Finance Systems). Michael will create the vendor record once we receive the questionnaire and W-9.
- Signatory: Emily Parker (CFO) signs for commitments above $50k.

We do intend to evaluate AWS Marketplace later, but procurement asks that the initial engagement be a direct PO so they can onboard the vendor in our payables system. Estimated vendor onboarding timeline: ~2–4 weeks after submission of the completed questionnaire and standard tax docs.

I’ve attached the vendor questionnaire we usually send suppliers. I’ll loop Michael if we need to escalate.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager 
Globex Corporation
sarah.lee@globex.com

Attachment stubs: globex_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@globex.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 07:48:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: procurement gatekeepers + payment path for Globex

Hi Sarah — looping in Sales Ops / Contracts to keep this moving. See a short checklist and next-actions below.

Short checklist (what Redwood will provide immediately):
- Completed vendor onboarding packet (we will return globex_vendor_questionnaire.pdf answered).
- W-9 / tax docs.
- Proposed MSA (we will send a 1–2 page SOW + MSA redline for review).

Commercial options (for clarity):
- Card (company card / automated billing): fastest to start (same-day), but procurement will need to relax PO requirement.
- PO (monthly invoicing / Net30): preferred for customers like Globex; we can support monthly or Net30 invoicing cadence — please confirm which you want on the PO.
- Marketplace: available as an option but typically adds procurement complexity for initial pilots.

Action items I can take immediately:
1) Send a completed copy of your questionnaire and our vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (attachment).
2) Share a draft MSA and a short SOW focused on the pilot scope (attachment: rwd_proposed_msa.docx).
3) Create a simple mutual action plan doc and a HubSpot timeline.

Sarah — can you confirm the invoicing cadence (Monthly vs Net30) and provide the preferred remit-to email for AP? If Michael is the billing contact, we’ll CC him on the vendor packet so he can open the vendor record.

Thanks — I’ll attach the packets to this thread.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (XLSX), rwd_proposed_msa.docx (DOCX)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@globex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement gatekeepers + payment path for Globex

Thanks Marissa — Monthly invoicing is preferred (vendor PO with monthly statements). Remit-to address: ap-payables@globex.com.

I will review the returned questionnaire and loop Michael if anything else is needed. We are targeting internal approvals the week of Dec 6; I’ll update you if we need a formal executive summary for Emily.

Appreciate the speed — will confirm when vendor record is created.

Regards,
Sarah
